chunks: 3706 - Al-Sadiq عليه السلام said regarding the saying of Allah, Mighty and Exalted:
There is no good in much of their secret talk except in one who enjoins charity, or kindness, or reconciliation between people.
So he said: "What is meant by al-ma'ruf is a loan."

key_terms.صَدَقَةٍ: charity given for the benefit of others
key_terms.مَعْرُوفٍ: recognized good; here interpreted as lending

ai.seo_question: What does al-ma'ruf mean in Qur'an 4:114 according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام explains this Qur'anic verse by identifying one meaning of al-ma'ruf as giving a loan. The hadith highlights that beneficial private counsel includes encouraging financial help that supports others and repairs social need.
